title: [Audit] API key activity and ownership
description: Named API keys, the human they are attributed to, and their request volume, busiest first.
esql: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE attributes.api_key.name IS NOT NULL | STATS events = COUNT(*), first_seen = MIN(@timestamp), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp), ips = COUNT_DISTINCT(client.ip), indices = COUNT_DISTINCT(attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices) BY api_key = attributes.api_key.name, key_id = attributes.api_key.id, owner = attributes.user.email | SORT events DESC
